build.summary: V31 is implemented with all four discriminators PASS. When the declared pattern of the coloured route has CheckColourings::total_groups_of(pattern) >= n, AssemblyOptions::default_first_use_check now returns CheckColumns::All. Otherwise it stays MultiColouring, and the dense route keeps Sample(8). total_groups_of is new and reads only the pattern (its CPR colouring, band and order), so no right-hand side is evaluated. It shares band_plan and refinement_plan with from_parts. Every check stays selectable. A vs B used the same programs (the V29 program unchanged, plus the new stage_clients_assembly_wide_band_record). The 36 identity runs match in every field. In the V26 corpus the rule changes only 6 correct ring patterns, where total_groups equals n; decisions and costs are unchanged. A 799-case supplement and a survey of 378 patterns were added. No declaration detected by A was missed by B, and no correct pattern was rejected. Two existing-test pins were edited, each with its reason recorded.

build.verdict: PASS: the V31 default (All where total_groups >= n) is implemented. The identity cells and corpus detection are unchanged, and the suites are green; independent review is still needed.
open_issues: Independent review is required by the contract (completion_requires).
The CHECKPOINT implemented_source_sha256 pin of crates/rodas5p-integrators/src/stage_clients/assembly.rs needs an update after the merge; multi.rs is not pinned.

On the V26 corpus the rule only fires at equality (6 correct ring patterns, same cost). The saving comes from irregular wide patterns: survey default-check right-hand sides fell from 70871 to 62792; supplement random patterns with total_groups > n fell from 2354 to 1608 (seq). Every full band in the survey has total_groups <= n.
On wrong declarations the full check can spend more right-hand sides before it fails than MC, with the same decision (supplement random omissions with total_groups > n: 6823 vs 7782, seq).
In general, a rounding-limited omission caught by MC's multi-column shifts but missed by All is not excluded; none occurred in the corpus or supplement.

Deviations of form: no PROTOCOL.json (the plan, the list and the programs were committed before commit A). The supplement was widened after two scratch smoke runs, before commit A (NOTES entry 3). The CARGO_TARGET_DIR was seeded by copying the w3-v26 release directory to reuse registry dependencies.
